What is a Client Management System?

A client management system is a software application that helps businesses manage their interactions with clients, including contact information, job scheduling, invoicing, and communication. For plumbers, a client management system can help you keep track of customer information, schedule appointments, and manage jobs from start to finish.

With Base44, you can create a custom client management system that meets the specific needs of your plumbing business. Key Features of a Client Management System for Plumbers

When building a client management system for plumbers, there are several key features to consider. These include:

  • Contact management: store customer contact information, including names, addresses, phone numbers, and email addresses
  • Job scheduling: schedule appointments and jobs, including date, time, and location
  • Invoicing and payment tracking: generate invoices and track payments, including payment status and due dates
  • Communication tools: send emails, texts, and notifications to customers, including reminders and updates
  • Reporting and analytics: track key metrics, including job completion rates, customer satisfaction, and revenue
